Add a student to an existing school class

Source: R/manual_class_list_functions.R
add_student_to_school_class.Rd

Add a student to an existing school class

Usage

add_student_to_school_class(
  data,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  class_name,
  dob = NA,
  upn = NA,
  ...,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A class-list data frame using configured or internal column names.

first_name, last_name

Name of new student.

class_name

Existing class name to copy class and teacher information from.

dob

Date of birth.

upn

UPN, if known.

...

Exactly one named school identifier, using an internal lookup key or configured external name, e.g. `URN = 123456`, `EST_ID = '001'`, or `est_wonde_id = 'A123'`.

verbose

Print informative messages.

Value

Updated data frame using the configured column names.
